question: Can you tell me the interest rate for a 30-year mortgage?
expected_answer: About 7.13% rate / 7.27% APR for loans up to $100k, up to 7.25% rate / 7.29% APR (loans up to $832,750), per the rate generation effective 2026-09-25.

question: What are the mortgage rates right now?
expected_answer: Lead with the $100k loan-amount tier: 30-year 7.13% plus the 15-year 6.25%; do not quote the $300k tier as the headline.

question: What credit cards do you offer and what are their APRs?
expected_answer: Four cards: Platinum Visa 12.50%-19.50% APR, Rewards Visa 15.50%-21.00% APR, Business Platinum Visa variable 15.50% APR, Business Rewards Visa variable 20.50% APR.

question: What are Dupaco's general lobby hours?
expected_answer: Lobby hours vary by branch (e.g. Mon–Thu 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m., Fri 8:30–6 or 5:30, Sat 8:30–12:30 or 9–noon); give a typical schedule and ask which branch.

question: What are the drive-up hours?
expected_answer: Drive-up hours at most branches: Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; Saturday varies (9–noon or 8–1); Sunday ATM only. Ask which branch for exact hours.

question: How many branches does Dupaco have?
What recognition has Dupaco received from Forbes?
expected_answer: Forbes has recognized Dupaco five times as a top (Best-in-State) credit union; the latest release says it was the fifth time.

question: What link should I use to see Dupaco's CD / certificate rates?
What are your lobby hours?
expected_answer: Answer the general lobby hours directly (do not demand ZIP/city first); if branches differ, ask 'which branch, or all branches?'

question: I would like to know the rates for the credit cards
expected_answer: Include personal cards (Platinum Visa standard 12.5%, Rewards Visa 15.5%-21%) as well as business cards (15.5%, 20.5%), not just business cards plus an intro rate.

question: Do any Dupaco savings tiers pay 0.35% APY?
expected_answer: No - the Share Savings tiers top out at 0.20% APY ($25,000+); a 0.00%-0.35% range is not on the rate sheet.

question: What is Dupaco's Home$tart program?
expected_answer: Home$tart (FHLB) provides up to $15,000 toward down payment and closing costs for first-time homebuyers.

question: Get me the rate for the certificate of accounts.
expected_answer: Read back all certificate rates/terms rather than asking which term (CDs are an explicit exception to term disambiguation).
must_not_include: Which certificate term would you like

question: Who is eligible to become a Dupaco member?
expected_answer: People who live or work in Dupaco's charter area of counties in Iowa, Illinois and Wisconsin.

question: How can I update my contact information with Dupaco?
expected_answer: Log in to your account (Shine) or call 800-373-7600 - no authentication needed to get this info.

question: Do all Dupaco branches keep the same lobby hours?
expected_answer: No - at least two lobby schedules are on file: Mon-Thu 8:30 a.m.-5 p.m., Fri 8:30 a.m.-6 p.m., Sat 8:30 a.m.-12:30 p.m., Sun closed; and Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-5 p.m. with Sat/Sun closed. Ask which branch.
